input.reason: The claim holds. `isolation.lastAppendID()` returns the last appendID that was handed out (`appendsOpenList.appendID`), and that ID can still belong to an appender that hasn't committed yet. In Prometheus an appender gets its appendID when it is created and releases it on Commit. So if an appender with ID N is open when the watermark is captured, the watermark is also N. The block writer's isolation `State()` then treats N as incomplete and leaves its samples out of the block.
